content.title: Hockey BOGO (Buy One, Get One) - Chipotle
content.text: What is the Chipotle Hockey BOGO deal? The Chipotle Hockey BOGO (Buy One, Get One) deal is a limited-time promotion where guests who wear a hockey jersey can receive a free entrée with the purchase of another entrée at participating Chipotle locations. This offer is part of Chipotle’s Jersey Day celebration and is available in-restaurant only. How does the Chipotle Hockey BOGO work? To redeem the Chipotle Hockey BOGO offer, visit a participating Chipotle location wearing a hockey jersey. Purchase one regular-priced entrée, and you’ll receive a second entrée of equal or lesser value for free. The offer is valid for in-store orders only and may require verification of jersey participation. How many free entrées can you get with Chipotle Hockey BOGO? Chipotle allows up to five (5) BOGO redemptions per person during the Hockey Jersey promotion. This means each guest wearing a jersey can receive up to five free entrées with the purchase of five entrées, making it easy to enjoy the deal while supplies last. Which Chipotle locations are participating in Hockey BOGO? The Chipotle Hockey BOGO promotion is available at participating locations across the U.S and Canada. Availability may vary by restaurant, so it’s recommended to check with your local Chipotle or visit the Chipotle website to confirm participation before heading in. Can you use Chipotle Rewards or other offers with Hockey BOGO? Chipotle Hockey BOGO offers cannot typically be combined with other promotions, rewards, or promo codes. To maximize value, guests can redeem rewards on a separate purchase or save them for a future visit.
